svg.title: TypeScript source is checked by the type checker, which reports errors in the editor and in CI; then the types are erased and plain JavaScript runs in Node, Deno, Bun or the browser

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Noto Sans', sans-serif
ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Noto Sans', sans-serif

svg.text: Checking and running are separate steps. Types never reach the runtime.
